Interfaces on FortiGate 370xF and 480xF remain down when upgrading to FortiOS 7.6.7 or 7.6.8.

When performing LDAP user search from the GUI against a LDAP server with large number of users (more than 100K), the FortiGate may experience slowness and freeze due to HTTPSD process consumes too much memory. User may need to kill the HTTPSD process or perform a reboot to recover.
observations.workaround: User can perform LDAP user search via the CLI.

observations.description: Agentless FSSO connector issues occur when using Windows 2025 due to MS introduced additional restrictions to remote Event log reading.
Unable to access the FortiGate VM web interface deployed on AWS when ACME is enabled.
The device encounters an issue where options in the ftgd-wf section cannot be unset when configuring a web filter via an Ansible playbook
In a rare situation, the file filter may mistakenly classify PDF files as BAT files, leading to an undesired blockage of these files.
